package assignments;

public class AllZerosToTheEnd {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub

		/*
		 * Move All Zeros to the End
			Write a Java program to move all zeros to the end of an array while maintaining the relative order of the non-zero elements.
			
			**Input:**
			{0, 5, 0, 3, 8, 0, 2, 9}`
		 */
		
		int[] arrNum = {0, 5, 0, 3, 8, 0, 2, 9};
		//arrNum[0]=0;
		int index = 0;
		for(int Iter=0;Iter<arrNum.length;Iter++)
		{
			if(arrNum[Iter]!=0)//0-0,1-5
			{
				arrNum[index] = arrNum[Iter];//5
				index++;
			}
			
		}
		System.out.println(index);
		while(index<arrNum.length)
		{
			arrNum[index] = 0;
			index++;
		}
			
		//System.out.println(arrNum[index]);
		for(int Iter=0;Iter<arrNum.length;Iter++)
		{
			System.out.println(arrNum[Iter]);
		}
	}

}
